subject: HOF: first-useful-inner-presentation has a distinct ~90 ms post-handoff stage and no opening frame-commit receipt
body: R&D-only handoff at unchanged main bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea. CONFIRMED: current telemetry cannot measure beta's first-useful-inner-pixels metric. Fold7Gen3VisualCoordinator delegates OPENING rendering to PanelEngine; all 10 gen3-cover-frame-commit events in the supplied Gen4 Alpha1 field log are CLOSING and opening=0. The continuity opening renderer is cover-geometry-only. In the two clean true-edge openings (movements/generations corresponding to Slot02's gen21 and gen77), first logged inner frozen-frame attachment follows INNER_HANDOFF by ~89.7 ms in both cycles. That event proves an attached inner snapshot surface, not physical scanout, so useful pixels still require a real frame receipt/device measurement. STRONG HYPOTHESIS: this deterministic post-handoff presentation stage is a separate contributor that can be reduced independently of shell wake. Proposed opening-only Presentation Gate: semantic opening token; stage receipts through inner topology/content/frame commit; immediately bridge with a safe valid cached inner snapshot at handoff, replace with fresh non-black capture asynchronously; never alter close thresholds/Gen4 close authority. Latest Slot02 finding adds that 8/10 captured cycles are dominated even earlier by a 503-2486 ms 0->1-to-coarse-90 trigger delay; fix/measure that first, but retain this presentation gate because it affects the clean cycles after true early edges. Device A/B is required before integration.
